page: Microsoft Azure E48s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 24 physical cores (2 threads per core) powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. The x86_64 CPU configuration includes advanced vector and matrix acceleration instructions such as AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8, complemented by a massive 480 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is substantial, providing 384.0 GB of RAM with an 8.0 GB-per-vCPU ratio. This instance features no bundled local storage and includes zero GPUs, relying entirely on remote network-attached disks for persistence.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong computational and data handling metrics. The E48s_v7 achieves a PassMark CPU score of 68,865.84 and PassMark extended instructions test of 63,330.94, both ranking in the top 25%. Cached memory read throughput reaches 3,690.93 GB/sec, while uncached memory bandwidth sustains 175.88 GB/sec for reads and 69.26 GB/sec for writes. Single-threaded gzip compression ranks in the top 10% at 36.68 GB/sec, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression hits 321.51 GB/sec. Although general stress-ng multi-core metrics sit in the middle 50% (50,493.6), the instance achieves strong results in database operations (22,699.83) and delivers 83.33 million Redis SET operations per second.

The 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this server cost-effective for memory-constrained workloads where compute requirements are moderate relative to memory footprint. CPU-based inference workloads also demonstrate competitive efficiency, processing 353.0 text generation tokens per second on small 135M models and 27.93 tokens per second on 7B models. A key operational tradeoff is the complete absence of local disk, which requires provisioning network storage volumes for any file-system workloads. Microsoft Azure E48s_v7 is well suited for in-memory databases, caching layers, high-throughput web serving, and analytical ETL pipelines.

The CPU features 480 MB of L3 cache with AVX-512 and AMX matrix instructions. It includes no local storage or GPUs.
